page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-32 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 32 dedicated virtual central processing units (vCPUs) paired with 60.0 gigabytes of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 1.88 gigabytes per vCPU, prioritizing raw processing power over memory capacity.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled graphics processing units, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and low memory-to-vCPU ratio make this instance a resource-dense option for compute-heavy workloads, minimizing memory overhead costs while maximizing parallel processing capabilities.

The c4d-highcpu-32 is designed for workloads that demand significant CPU resources but have modest memory footprints. Suitable applications include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, video encoding, and compute-intensive web serving or microservices.
